title: AID Protocol v2 — DeliveryGate
description: Artifact emitted by C1 (delivery gate checker) after running structural and completeness gate checks on the implementation.

allOf.$comment: extends aid-protocol-v2.schema.json envelope (reference only — not a resolved $ref)

producer.description: Tool identifier that produced this artifact, e.g. 'aid-delivery-gate@2.0'

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of artifact creation

epic_id.description: The EPIC this gate belongs to, or null for a PLAN-LEVEL aggregate (P068 Step 3): the plan-final delivery gate is aggregated from every contributing EPIC's evidence pack and is bound to identity.plan_id instead. The key stays REQUIRED — an absent epic_id is still a malformed artifact; an explicit null is the plan-level shape.

plan_id.description: Set (with epic_id null) on the plan-level aggregate produced at the plan-final review boundary.

subject_hash.description: sha256 hash of the delivery_gate payload object (deterministic content hash)

head_sha.description: Git HEAD SHA the gate was produced against — the AUTHORITATIVE reference for freshness (IMP-264). Consumers compute freshness at read time by comparing this against current HEAD.

base_sha.description: Base commit SHA provided via --base (run start reference)

head_is_current.description: DEPRECATED, NON-AUTHORITATIVE creation-time snapshot (IMP-264): true only because head_sha equalled HEAD at creation. Becomes a false claim once another commit lands; consumers MUST recompute freshness from head_sha, never trust this boolean.

freshness.description: DEPRECATED, NON-AUTHORITATIVE creation-time snapshot (IMP-264). Recompute from head_sha at read time.

status.description: Overall artifact status — pass if delivery_ready, fail otherwise

kind.description: Verdict kind for delivery gate artifacts

value.description: true if all applicable checks passed and freshness is fresh

dispatch_mode.description: How this artifact was produced; delivery gate uses 'deterministic'

generated_by_tool.description: Tool name that generated this artifact, e.g. 'aid-delivery-gate'

delivery_gate.$comment: Full delivery gate payload — all fields are enforced

phase.description: Gate phase: D0=post-execute observe, D1=pre-release blocking (future)

freshness.description: Delivery-level freshness: fresh if HEAD==base_sha, stale if commits landed after run start

delivery_ready.description: true only if all applicable checks passed, freshness=fresh, no unverifiable (when block_on_unverifiable=true)

checks.description: Per-check results for all 12 delivery gate checks (dg01..dg12)

findings.description: Optional per-finding list following protocol-v2 finding schema

check_status.description: Result of a single delivery gate check

name.description: Human-readable check name matching the check script name (e.g. 'dependency-consistency')

skip_reason.description: Reason for skip/unverifiable; empty string for pass/fail results. Must be in skip_reason_allowlist when status=skip.

output_preview.description: First N lines of check script stdout+stderr (N controlled by output_preview_lines in policy)

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time in milliseconds for this check script invocation

summary.description: Aggregate counts and block decision across all checks

skip.description: Number of checks skipped (not applicable or policy-overridden)

unverifiable.description: Number of checks that could not be verified (missing tooling, no command, timeout)

would_block.description: In observe mode: reflects whether delivery_ready=false (what would happen if enforcement were active)
